en.title: Australian politics live: Burke rubbishes claims of 'mass migration' and denies One Nation influenced Labor's policy
en.summary: Labor minister Burke rejected claims that the government's migration policy was influenced by One Nation, while opposition figure Barnaby Joyce argued that Labor's measures on international student families and visa restrictions resembled One Nation proposals.

en.title: Prominent athlete tells Alan Jones trial he sent shirtless photo before unwanted kiss he wished 'never happened'
en.summary: During cross-examination in the trial of former broadcaster Alan Jones on sexual assault charges, a complainant testified that an unwanted kiss from Jones over a decade ago remains vivid in his memory and that he had previously sent Jones a shirtless photograph.

en.summary: Labor announced new immigration policy changes including restrictions on international students' family members and a ballot system for backpackers, with the migration minister criticizing One Nation's approach to migration levels.

en.title: Trump calls EU offer to Canada of associate membership 'laughable', while threatening tariffs
en.summary: US President Trump threatened the European Union with significant tariffs and reduced trade after the bloc proposed making Canada its first associate member. Trump characterized the proposal as a hostile act.

stories.title: Teenage boys charged with murder after alleged mistaken identity shooting of Sydney student

en.title: Teenage boys charged with murder after alleged mistaken identity shooting of Sydney student
en.summary: Two teenagers aged 14 and 16 have been charged with murder following the September shooting death of 23-year-old university student Marco Tapia in his family home. Police believe the shooting was a case of mistaken identity.

en.title: 'Mobilisation of fear': The deeper strategy behind One Nation's immigration policy
en.summary: One Nation's rise is creating concerns among temporary migrants about their future security. The party's immigration policy approach is characterized as using fear as a strategic tool.

en.summary: Support acts including Finneas left Ed Sheeran's tour after Macklemore was removed for pro-Palestinian comments. Other musicians demonstrated commitment to free speech advocacy despite Sheeran's stated apolitical approach to making change.
